source_summary: Tall monochrome ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with misty cliffs, pines, waterside architecture, waterfalls, bridges, and mounted travelers. Motifs exclude borders, seals, calligraphy, and paper texture.

motifs.name: distant_left_mist_peaks
motifs.description: Soft, pale distant mountain silhouettes emerging from mist on the left middle of the composition, including the tall rounded peak and lower layered hill masses beside the water.
must_preserve: translucent ink wash silhouettes
soft mist-blurred edges
subtle tonal layering between tall peak and lower hills
faint horizontal water haze at the base

motifs.name: upper_right_cliff_shrine
motifs.description: Steep upper-right cliff face with a small shrine or balcony structure tucked into the rock, including the seated figure-like detail inside, surrounding ledges, sparse trees, and dark vertical rock washes.
must_preserve: angular cliff contour lines
dark vertical wash streaks on the rock
delicate roof and railing geometry of the small shrine
tiny seated interior figure detail
sparse foliage tufts clinging to ledges
mist-softened lower cliff edges

motifs.name: central_pine_cliff_mass
motifs.description: Central towering rock mass with jagged vertical sides, ledges, clustered shrubs, and pine growth, forming the main mountain spine through the middle of the painting.
must_preserve: layered rock texture strokes
dark ink crevices along the vertical cliff
pine branch linework and needle clusters
small shrub dots and leaf clusters along ledges
irregular mist gaps cutting across the mountain
washed tonal transitions from dark foreground rock to pale background slopes

motifs.name: mid_left_lakeside_pavilion
motifs.description: Elaborate pavilion or palace building floating beside misty water at mid-left, with layered roofs, railings, decorative eaves, and reflection-like horizontal ink marks beneath.
must_preserve: precise roof ridge and tiled eave linework
stacked pavilion roof geometry
balustrades and small ornamental posts
fine architectural interior lines
soft water reflection strokes below the building
misty separation from surrounding rocks

motifs.name: lower_left_waterfall_rapids
motifs.description: Lower-left cascade and stream section with falling water over rocks, curling rapids, and dark foreground stones near the bank.
must_preserve: parallel curved waterfall strokes
foamy spiral water patterns
dark rock outlines framing the falls
layered bank contours
fine ripple lines in the water
contrast between pale flowing water and ink-dark stones

motifs.name: foreground_bridge_cavalcade
motifs.description: Lower-left foreground arched bridge with railings and several mounted travelers crossing it, including horses, riders, bridge posts, and water swirling below.
must_preserve: bridge plank perspective and arched support geometry
upright railing posts and horizontal rails
fine outlines of horses and riders
individual horse legs and heads
flowing water curls beneath the bridge
delicate figure garments and reins

motifs.name: center_path_lone_rider
motifs.description: Small mounted traveler on a narrow central path beneath the cliff, with the horse, rider, nearby attendant-like marks, and the enclosing rock face around the path.
must_preserve: small horse outline and legs
rider robe and head detail
thin vertical path linework
adjacent dark cliff edge
nearby brushy shrubs
scale contrast between tiny figure and massive rock

motifs.name: right_mid_pine_grove
motifs.description: Large right-side pine grove with sweeping branches, dense rounded needle clusters, twisting trunks, and rocky ground beneath, separate from the mounted figures below.
must_preserve: radiating pine needle clusters
curving branch structure
dark ink accents on branch joints
twisted trunk linework
layered foliage density from pale to dark ink
rock and shrub texture at the base

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
